"""Execute ONLY via official Blender MCP in an explicitly handed-off empty scene.
Native VSE edit of proven ecosystem audio. No subprocess, CLI or old blend load.
"""
import bpy,hashlib,json,math,wave
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/trail-ecosystem-recovery')
IN=ROOT/'inputs'; manifest_path=IN/'manifest.json'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text());s=bpy.context.scene
receipt_path=ROOT/'audio-edit-readback.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists(), 'Preserve existing evidence before any scene mutation'
assert len(s.objects)==0 and (s.sequence_editor is None or len(s.sequence_editor.strips)==0), 'Dedicated empty scene required'
assert manifest['fps']==100 and manifest['duration_seconds']==28.6
assets={Path(a['local_file']).stem:a for a in manifest['audio']}; assert len(assets)==17
# Validate every source and every edit before mutating the scene.
for a in assets.values():
 p=IN/a['local_file'];assert p.parent==IN and p.is_file()
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['sha256']
 with wave.open(str(p)) as w:
  assert w.getframerate()==48000 and w.getsampwidth()==3
  assert w.getnframes()==a['frames'] and w.getnchannels()==a['channels']
  assert hashlib.sha256(w.readframes(w.getnframes())).hexdigest()==a['original_render_pcm_sha256']
last=0
for edit in manifest['timeline']:
 assert edit['asset'] in assets
 start=edit['start_seconds'];duration=edit['duration_seconds']
 assert math.isfinite(start) and math.isfinite(duration) and start>=last and duration>0
 assert duration<=assets[edit['asset']]['frames']/48000+1e-8
 assert abs(start*100-round(start*100))<1e-7 and abs(duration*100-round(duration*100))<1e-7
 last=start+duration
assert last<=28.6 and len(manifest['timeline'])==17
s.render.fps=100;s.render.fps_base=1;s.frame_start=1;s.frame_end=2860
ed=s.sequence_editor_create();rows=[]
for edit in manifest['timeline']:
 start=1+round(edit['start_seconds']*100);length=round(edit['duration_seconds']*100)
 strip=ed.strips.new_sound(edit['asset'],str(IN/assets[edit['asset']]['local_file']),channel=1,frame_start=start)
 strip.frame_final_duration=length;strip.volume=1
 fade=5 if edit['asset'] in ('environment_soft_wind_foliage_loop','music_sparse_tonal_loop') else 0
 if fade:
  for frame,value in [(start,0),(start+fade,1),(start+length-fade,1),(start+length,0)]:
   strip.volume=value;strip.keyframe_insert(data_path='volume',frame=frame)
 rows.append({'name':strip.name,'start_frame':start,'duration_frames':length,'fade_frames':fade,'source_sha256':assets[edit['asset']]['sha256']})
assert s.animation_data and s.animation_data.action
act=s.animation_data.action;curves={}
# Blender 4.5 can expose legacy FCurves or layered Action channel bags.
try:
 for curve in act.fcurves:curves[curve.as_pointer()]=curve
except AttributeError:
 pass
for layer in getattr(act,'layers',[]):
 for action_strip in layer.strips:
  for bag in getattr(action_strip,'channelbags',[]):
   for curve in bag.fcurves:curves[curve.as_pointer()]=curve
assert len(curves)==2, ('Unexpected native fade channels',len(curves))
for curve in curves.values():
 assert curve.data_path.endswith('.volume')
 for key in curve.keyframe_points:key.interpolation='LINEAR'
 curve.update()
# Actual evaluated readback, not just assignment receipts.
for row in rows:
 strip=ed.strips[row['name']]
 assert strip.frame_final_start==row['start_frame'] and strip.frame_final_duration==row['duration_frames']
 if row['fade_frames']:
  for frame,expected in [(row['start_frame'],0),(row['start_frame']+5,1),(row['start_frame']+row['duration_frames']-5,1),(row['start_frame']+row['duration_frames']-1,0.2),(row['start_frame']+row['duration_frames'],0)]:
   s.frame_set(frame);assert abs(strip.volume-expected)<1e-6
s.frame_set(1)
report={'status':'native-edit-readback-passed','input_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'fps':100,'duration_seconds':28.6,'strips':rows,'new_fade_scope':manifest['fade_scope'],'not_claimed':['encoding','native reopen','subjective listening']}
p=receipt_path;p.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report))
